name: Autosomal Uniparental Disomy Syndrome

criteria.description: Molecular genetic confirmation of uniparental disomy via SNP array or microsatellite analysis
Presence of clinical features consistent with imprinting disorders or recessive conditions caused by UPD
Demonstration of biparental inheritance exclusion by parental origin testing
Abnormal methylation patterns consistent with imprinting defects

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Molecular genetic confirmation of UPD plus clinical features consistent with imprinting or recessive disorders caused by UPD
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of molecular, clinical, and parental origin data.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Segmental or complete isodisomy detected by molecular analysis
pathognomonic.notes: Molecular hallmark rather than clinical symptom

pathognomonic.symptomName: Imprinting disorder phenotype specific to chromosome involved (e.g., growth retardation in maternal UPD7)
searchTerms: growth delay due to chromosome imprinting

pathognomonic.symptomName: Recessive disorder manifestation due to homozygosity from isodisomy
searchTerms: genetic disorder from identical chromosome copies
baby smaller than expected in womb

occasional.symptomName: Behavioral abnormalities including autism spectrum features

laboratory: Abnormal methylation patterns on chromosome-specific imprinting centers
Homozygosity for recessive mutations detected by sequencing
Normal karyotype with uniparental origin confirmed by microsatellite or SNP analysis
imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific delayed myelination or structural abnormalities
Echocardiography to identify congenital heart defects
genetic: Uniparental isodisomy or heterodisomy confirmed by molecular genetic testing
Parental origin testing demonstrating biparental inheritance exclusion
other: Clinical phenotype consistent with known imprinting disorders (e.g., Silver-Russell syndrome, Prader-Willi syndrome)
Family history negative for similar recessive disorders in some cases

distinguishingFeatures: Growth retardation with characteristic facial features
Hypomethylation of 11p15 rather than UPD of other chromosomes
Deletion or maternal UPD15 rather than autosomal UPD

redFlags: Severe intrauterine growth retardation without clear cause
Developmental delay with unexplained imprinting disorder features
Recessive disorder phenotype in absence of family history
references: Eggermann T, et al. Uniparental disomy and imprinting disorders. Am J Med Genet C Semin Med Genet. 2015.
Kotzot D. Complex and segmental uniparental disomy updated. J Med Genet. 2008.
Benn P. Uniparental disomy: origin, frequency and clinical significance. Prenat Diagn. 2008.
